Cognitive impairment in 80-99%; cardiac defects, glaucoma and urinary tract abnormalities each 30-79%. Hearing impairment omitted under cap; lung lobation alone need not impair function.
Reproductive organ malignancy umbrella; reproductive organs have no axis. Endocrine subtypes do not characterize most cases.
Cerebral motor disorder causing spasticity and ataxia; motor manifestations do not establish primary skeletal muscle disease.
Skeletal muscle calcium-handling disorder; acidosis and tachyarrhythmias are acute downstream effects. Renal, hepatic and heart failure occur in fewer than 30%.
Glioblastoma subtype arising in the central nervous system.
Testicular descent abnormality is reproductive; no established common renal involvement or endocrine dysfunction.
Inherited erythrocytosis with increased haemoglobin, haematocrit and red cell mass.
Intellectual disability, epilepsy and IgA deficiency define syndrome. Conjunctival telangiectasias and unspecified dental anomalies do not establish functional damage.
Skeletal muscle channelopathy causing fluctuating myotonia; potassium sensitivity does not establish a systemic metabolic disorder.
Penile carcinoma arises in a reproductive organ. HPV association does not make the carcinoma itself an infectious disease.
Defining phenotype comprises cerebral malformation and seizures, excessive hair growth and overlapping fingers.
Benign vascular neoplasm; no specific host organ is established by this concept.
Inherited intrahepatic cholestasis progressing to periportal fibrosis and cirrhosis; no established extrahepatic organ damage.
Inherited central movement disorder characterized by myoclonus and dystonia.
Rickettsia helvetica infection; no specific organ damage is established as common or defining.
Invasive urothelial carcinoma originating in the bladder; lymphoma-like morphology does not establish lymphoma.
Benign neoplasm arising from bone or articular cartilage.
Epithelial neoplasm originating in intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts, both covered by hepatic.
Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma with defining malignant blood lymphocytes. Frequent hepatomegaly alone does not establish hepatic infiltration or dysfunction.
Benign neoplasm confined to breast ducts; breast has no axis.
Central movement disorder causing episodic dystonia and choreoathetosis; no common direct muscle or joint damage.
Congenital multiple joint contracture syndrome; no evidence of a separate neurologic or other organ disorder.
Occlusion of the ophthalmic artery directly causes severe ocular ischaemia and potentially permanent visual loss.
Defining skeletal dysplasia affects ribs and pelvis; defining laryngeal stenosis affects the airway.
